instruction: A candid outdoor photograph in a medium full shot captures two men walking along a beach. They stroll on the wet sandy shoreline next to calm water during the late afternoon. On the right, the man in the dark grey long-sleeve shirt and white ripped jeans (R1) walks forward with a smile, looking ahead. Beside him on the left, the man in the blue t-shirt and light blue shorts (R2), wearing sunglasses, walks in unison. They hold hands, with the man in the dark shirt's (R1) left hand clasped in the other man's (R2) right hand. Warm, natural sunlight illuminates them from the side, casting soft shadows on the sand against a bright, hazy background.
